title: GLB skinning/weighting broken at runtime but works during preview.
body:
### Tested versions

I am encountering a bug when importing GLB files with multiple animations.

In the "Import Settings Preview" the animations play perfectly and faithfully replicate the original Blender file.
However, during actual output (authoring), the skinning and weights do not behave correctly.

Attached is a 27-second video demonstrating the issue, along with the source file to replicate the error.

Godot v4.5.1

[Bug Report 27 seconds video.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26761448/Bug.Report.27.seconds.video.zip)
